description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for 18S rRNA marker-gene sequencing of eukaryotic microbial communities in freshwater lake ecosystems, including spatial, temporal, environmental, and sequencing descriptors.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample record.

lake_id.descr: Unique identifier or name for the lake from which the sample was collected.

lake_name.descr: Human-readable lake name, if different from lake_id.

region_name.descr: Geographic region, watershed, province/state, or broader study area where the lake is located.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

sampling_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

season.descr: Season of sampling; use a controlled vocabulary such as spring, summer, autumn/fall, winter.

sampling_depth_m.descr: Sampling depth below the water surface in meters (m).

depth_zone.descr: Lake depth zone or habitat category, for example epilimnion, metalimnion, hypolimnion, littoral, pelagic, benthic.

water_column_position.descr: Relative position in the water column, if applicable; for example surface, midwater, near-bottom.

sample_matrix.descr: Material sampled; typically lake water for 18S rRNA amplicon sequencing.

sample_volume_l.descr: Volume of water filtered or otherwise processed for DNA extraction, in liters.

filtration_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size used for collection/retention of microorganisms, in micrometers (um).

preservation_method.descr: Method used to preserve the sample before extraction; for example freezing, ethanol, RNAlater, immediate filtration.

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature in degrees Celsius (°C).

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in milligrams per liter (mg/L).

dissolved_oxygen_percent.descr: Dissolved oxygen saturation in percent (%), if measured.

pH.descr: Water pH measured in situ or from a contemporaneous water sample.

conductivity_us_cm.descr: Specific conductivity in microsiemens per centimeter (µS/cm).

turbidity_ntu.descr: Turbidity in nephelometric turbidity units (NTU), if measured.

secchi_depth_m.descr: Secchi disk depth in meters (m), if measured.

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration in micrograms per liter (µg/L), if measured.

nitrate_n_mg_l.descr: Nitrate concentration expressed as nitrogen in milligrams per liter (mg N/L).

nitrite_n_mg_l.descr: Nitrite concentration expressed as nitrogen in milligrams per liter (mg N/L).

ammonium_n_mg_l.descr: Ammonium concentration expressed as nitrogen in milligrams per liter (mg N/L).

total_nitrogen_mg_l.descr: Total nitrogen concentration in milligrams per liter (mg/L), if measured.

orthophosphate_p_mg_l.descr: Orthophosphate concentration expressed as phosphorus in milligrams per liter (mg P/L).

total_phosphorus_mg_l.descr: Total phosphorus concentration in milligrams per liter (mg/L), if measured.

dissolved_organic_carbon_mg_l.descr: Dissolved organic carbon concentration in milligrams per liter (mg/L), if measured.

water_transparency_comment.descr: Free-text notes on water clarity, ice cover, algal blooms, or other visible conditions relevant to interpretation.

lake_area_km2.descr: Lake surface area in square kilometers (km^2), if known for the sampled lake.

max_depth_m.descr: Maximum depth of the lake in meters (m), if known.

trophic_state.descr: Lake trophic classification, for example oligotrophic, mesotrophic, eutrophic, hypertrophic.

zone_definition_method.descr: Description of how the depth or habitat zone was defined, for example fixed depth thresholds or thermocline-based stratification.

target_gene.descr: Marker gene targeted by the assay; for this study, typically 18S rRNA.

amplicon_region.descr: 18S rRNA region amplified, for example V4, V9, or another specified region.

forward_primer_sequence.descr: Forward primer sequence used for amplification, written 5' to 3'.

reverse_primer_sequence.descr: Reverse primer sequence used for amplification, written 5' to 3'.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform or instrument used, for example Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, PacBio.

library_protocol.descr: Brief description or name of the library preparation protocol.

replicate_number.descr: Biological or technical replicate number for the sample, if applicable.

is_field_duplicate.descr: True if the sample is a field duplicate; otherwise false.

is_filter_blank.descr: True if the record represents a filtration blank or negative control; otherwise false.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used.

pcr_cycles.descr: Number of PCR amplification cycles used for library preparation.

notes.descr: Additional sample-level notes relevant to collection, environmental conditions, or processing.
